endButton: Give GAMAN Power Token to Sawtelle Spirit

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: SACHI: Hi! I'm Sachi. I am here to guide you.

dialogues.speaker: player
dialogues.text: YOU: Nice to meet you, Sachi!

dialogues.speaker: player
dialogues.text: Look Sachi, something's glowing in that window!

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: It's Yamaguchi Store, the neighborhood's general store. Let's go inside.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: HENRY YAMAGUCHI: Hi Sachi, what brings you here today?

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Hello Mr. Yamaguchi! What is that token in your window?

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: That's Japanese for GAMAN. It means enduring life's hardships with patience.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: During World War II, our family lost everything so we had to GAMAN.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: That must have been so difficult…

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Yes it was difficult, but we had GAMAN, so we carried on.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: My brother Jack especially had to endure so much when we came back to Sawtelle.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Oh, that's so sad. I can see how he had to have GAMAN to get through that time.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Please take this token as a reminder of GAMAN.
